what: A read of every run that made at least one claim, looking for statements about the investigated line itself that no collected source supports. It is separate from the pass or fail of a case: the automatic checks do not read the claims.
reader: Drafted with an AI assistant from the raw runs, the collected evidence and the diffs of the commits involved. Not checked by a second person.
